title: pentacalia chiribogae
intro: Pentacalia chiribogae, commonly known as Chiriboga, is a plant species native to the Andean region of Ecuador. It is a member of the Asteraceae family and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chiriboga include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Chiriboga include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
